comparison: Scene comparison uses this portrait run Before snapshots. Runtime uses runtime-code-before.json with explicit true Framing before override. Original level/source/prefab/animation/GUID invariants are recomputed against the full pre-art Assets backup, a stronger older reference. Serialization whitespace, reference type hints, and harmless float resave precision use rel=1e-6/abs=1e-7 tolerances.

review.framingReview: Presentation only: fit camera and clipping; relocate camera-space Canvas UI depth; cache/disable/restore Image and Renderer components only within scene Canvas/fondo branches; draw their original meshes/textures/UV/tint through the dedicated unlit background shader before opaque board geometry, preserving source material data and explicit tint*ambient; reset only the rendered depth buffer. Board pieces, colliders, ports, events and gameplay state are not mutated.
review.localizationReview: Only ResizeExit and Apply(exitLang) differ: portrait logical-canvas sizeDelta and text fontSize/resizeTextMaxSize. Localized message lookup is preserved.
review.previewParticleScope: Only category clone instances in RestorePreviewMotion: Hierarchy scaling on their ParticleSystems; Classic grupo1Prefab exact CubFuenteGC3ZFIn/Font3(Clone) and CubFuenteGC2RoFin/Font4(Clone) startSize=.24..36. Emission, lifetime, velocity, shape, colors and native board ParticleSystems are untouched.
